Used simple food chains with arrows.

Teach-back was not passed; animal-eater classification was not independently correct.
end.parentNote: Manav practised sorting animals by what they eat and reading food chains with arrows. They connected grass with plants and built food-chain examples such as mango leaf → caterpillar; using arrows worked well. Animal diet categories still needed support and were not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask Manav to sort three animals into plant-eater, meat-eater, or both, then make one arrow chain.
